description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” illustrates Recall@10 values for four labeled methods. The category axis is horizontal, showing the labels “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking” in that left-to-right order, with the labels angled; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The value axis is vertical with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals (0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4). There are four vertical bars: “Ours” is colored orange and reaches approximately 0.35; “- critiquing” is blue at about 0.29; “- scoring” is blue at about 0.17; and “- ranking” is blue at about 0.235. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond being separate categories, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or sorting indicators beyond the displayed left-to-right order; the “Ours” bar is visually distinguished by its orange color while the others are blue.
